Container.Name: birdsong
Container.Overview:
Birdsong shows the birds your BirdNET-Go station has heard as a single plate of hand-cut 1800s illustrations, each bird sized by how often it called. Select a bird for its plate, a short description, its calls by hour and by day, and its latest recordings with playback.
Requires a running BirdNET-Go, or a public BirdWeather station such as a PUC. Set one below, then open the WebUI. The artwork is built into the image; the image is rebuilt weekly to pick up new birds.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: birdnet birdnet-go birds birdsong bird detection audio illustrations dashboard wildlife nature fugleramme
Container.Requires: BirdNET-Go, installed separately and reachable from this container; or a public BirdWeather station.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port the Birdsong page is served on.

Config.Name: BirdNET-Go Address
Config.Description: Address of your BirdNET-Go, with http:// and its port, for example http://192.168.1.50:8080. Use the server's IP, not localhost. Not needed when a BirdWeather station is set below.

Config.Name: BirdWeather Station
Config.Description: Optional. Instead of BirdNET-Go, draw the plate from a public BirdWeather station such as a PUC: the number at the end of its page, app.birdweather.com/stations/12345. Leave empty to use BirdNET-Go.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Persistent folder for anything that must survive container updates. Unraid's per-container Tailscale finds it automatically and keeps its state here, so Birdsong keeps one tailnet identity across updates.
